style: Palette of jade mint green, signal yellow and soft lilac accents over deep green-slate shadows. Clean, readable shapes like a polished top-down video game.

images.name: region-map
images.prompt: A colourful square-grid strategy map of one region seen from directly above, like a beautifully painted board game filling the whole wide frame: rivers, forests, hills, farmland, a small village, a mine, a city spread over several district tiles, a coastline with shallow sea, all laid out on a clear grid of square tiles with thin lines between them. Small chunky game pieces stand on a few tiles: a little figure token, a tracked vehicle token, a ship token on the sea, a horned monster token in a dark forest. Drifting white fog of war covers the right third of the map, hiding the unexplored tiles. Warm and readable. No text, numbers, labels, lettering or signatures anywhere.

images.name: arena
images.prompt: Top-down view looking straight down onto a wide rocky desert arena: a fleet of four armored vehicles of different sizes, a big tracked command vehicle and three smaller hover tanks, trades glowing shots and missiles with another fleet of four on the far side, dust trails behind them, a flat round landing pad in the centre of the arena, and wide gaps in the surrounding cliffs at the edges where vehicles can drive out.

images.name: tunnel
images.prompt: Top-down view of four sleek starships in formation streaking up through a long straight corridor of streaming blue and lilac hyperspace light, while ahead of them large translucent yellow targeting circles bloom on the corridor and bright shots rain down around the ships, the ships weaving aside with glowing engine trails.

images.name: aftermath
images.prompt: Top-down view of a forest clearing the day after a battle: shallow craters in the grass, a burnt patch of trees, a wrecked tracked vehicle lying on its side, crates of salvage stacked beside it, a small camp of tents where people gather, and a new dirt road being laid toward a village at the edge.

images.name: omnicure
images.prompt: Top-down view of a microscopic world inside a wide blood vessel: a small glowing jade artificial microbe craft with tiny cilia fires bright yellow pellets at spiky purple virus particles, red blood cells drifting past in a slow current, soft pink tissue walls on both sides, a few friendly round white cells nearby.

images.name: off-duty
images.prompt: Top-down view looking straight down into a cozy house and garden seen without its roof, like a life simulation video game: a person in a jade and yellow jumpsuit arranging furniture in a sunny living room with colourful rugs and potted plants, a neighbour watering flowers in the garden, a small vegetable patch, a picket fence and a path to a quiet street.

images.name: evolver-devourer
images.prompt: Top-down view of a sunny meadow where four odd little elemental monsters scuffle in a circle: a leafy green lizard spitting seeds, a round stony beetle rolling, a crackling yellow electric fox and a larger lava turtle puffing flame; a small floating fluffy fairy creature carrying a satchel hovers behind them; rocks and wildflowers scattered around.

images.name: astral
images.prompt: Top-down view of an empty night-time parking lot under street lamps: a young person in a hooded jacket stands in the centre while parked cars, crates and concrete chunks float in the air around them, held by a shimmering pale violet psychic aura, translucent hexagonal barrier panels hovering in a ring, wind-blown leaves swirling.

images.name: kaiju
images.prompt: High aerial view of a sunny coastal city and its harbour seawall: out in the shallow sea stands a colossal green reptile creature with a row of spines on its back, as big as a skyscraper, and between it and the seawall three huge boxy mechanical hover platforms with yellow stripes keep watch in a row, glowing yellow energy screens between them; ferries sail calmly away along the coast.

images.name: sunshine
images.prompt: Top-down view of a busy transport network across a sunny landscape: railway lines with long cargo trains, a highway interchange, a metro station, a harbour with ferries, an airport and a spaceport with a rocket on its pad, all connected in a tidy colour-coded layout with yellow and jade roofs.
